existing_data_group_check.meaning: Existing-image view splits. All free K/D/p fitted on training views; check views only refit their own poses. C97 starts were originally obtained from all views. Not new-image/board validation.

sampled_geometry_checks.meaning: Radial polynomial critical-point check and sufficient tangential positive-Jacobian bound over the ray-domain radius disk, plus sampled checks. Numerical floating-point analysis; not optical validation or a claim outside this domain.

local_identifiability_diagnostic.meaning: Local numerical identifiability diagnostic, not a statistical confidence interval or independent validation.

quantized_geometry_checks.meaning: Radial polynomial critical-point check and sufficient tangential positive-Jacobian bound over the ray-domain radius disk, plus sampled checks. Numerical floating-point analysis; not optical validation or a claim outside this domain.

1920x1080.meaning: Whole K,D,p and Kout Q16.16 estimate; sampled floating projection comparison, not RTL intermediate arithmetic proof.

quantized_geometry_checks.meaning: Radial polynomial critical-point check and sufficient tangential positive-Jacobian bound over the ray-domain radius disk, plus sampled checks. Numerical floating-point analysis; not optical validation or a claim outside this domain.

1280x720.meaning: Whole K,D,p and Kout Q16.16 estimate; sampled floating projection comparison, not RTL intermediate arithmetic proof.

source.coordinate_orientation: Original stored/detected coordinates; no extra rotate or mirror.

warnings: 本次仅用已有照片或保存角点；没有新拍照片、当前采集链路或实板验证。
这是新的整套K、四个鱼眼k和两个切向p；不得只提取p与旧K/k混用。
D始终是4项OpenCV鱼眼系数；p单独保存，不能直接追加到原生OpenCV fisheye D。
720文件只是同视野、同方向和既有像素中心规则下的尺寸派生，不是新的720光学标定。
所有参考映射只供离线检查，禁止代替FPGA生产映射计算。
棋盘物点仍按20×20mm正方格，未合入长方格比例/棋盘形变候选。
分组/数值检查不支持自动采用；维持已有正式版本，保留本结果作诊断。
